title: FBN Warehouse-Damage Case Decisions
content:
A warehouse-damage case is a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) seller's reimbursement case whose loss kind is damaged in warehouse: a claim for units damaged inside a Northloop fulfillment center. This policy fixes the units the support desk approves when it decides a seller's open warehouse-damage case; the approved units become the unit count of the case and the reimbursement run pays them afterwards.

## What the decision records

- The case, open with status submitted until it is decided, becomes **approved**.
- The unit count on the case becomes the units approved.
- The loss kind, source references and SKU of the decision are recorded again.
- No payment is made by the decision itself; Northloop's reimbursement run issues the reimbursement of the approved units separately.

## The decision tool

**Tool:** `approve_damaged_inventory_case_556f0f6d` — an agent-side tool, unlocked by the agent and then called by the agent.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | reference number of the seller's open FBN reimbursement case being decided, from the seller's case list returned by the FBN case lookup | identifier |
| `reimbursement_type` | loss kind recorded on the case | `lost_in_warehouse`, `damaged_in_warehouse`, `inbound_shortage`, `customer_return_not_received`, `removal_lost` or `not_applicable` |
| `adjustment_ref` | inventory adjustment reference the case names, copied from the case record | identifier, or empty string when the case names no single adjustment |
| `shipment_id` | inbound shipment number the case names, copied from the case record | identifier, or empty string |
| `order_id` | marketplace order number the case names, copied from the case record | identifier, or empty string |
| `removal_order_id` | removal order reference the case names, copied from the case record | identifier, or empty string |
| `sku` | seller SKU of the case | copied character for character from the case record (verbatim) |
| `units_approved` | units approved for reimbursement on the case | whole number of units, zero or more |

Meaning of the loss kinds: `damaged_in_warehouse`, units damaged inside a fulfillment center; `lost_in_warehouse`, units missing inside a fulfillment center; `inbound_shortage`, an inbound shipment line received short; `customer_return_not_received`, a refunded buyer return that never arrived; `removal_lost`, a removal shipment to the seller lost; `not_applicable`, a fee dispute rather than a loss claim.

### Return

A receipt with `case_id`, `sku`, `units_approved` (now shown as the case's unit count) and `case_status`, always `approved`. A returned receipt means the approval is recorded; no other outcome is defined.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A warehouse-damage case opened in March with status submitted is decided in April for 4 units: from that moment the case stands approved with a unit count of 4, and the reimbursement run pays the 4 units afterwards.
